dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君。帰ろ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, let's go home."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, let's go home."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "OK."
dialogues.text: "OK."

dialogues.jp: やたらと軽い鞄を持ち、席を立つ。
dialogues.en: I blindly reach for my bag, and stand up at my desk.
dialogues.text: I blindly reach for my bag, and stand up at my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、これから、桜公園に付き合ってくれな
　い？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you mind if we go to the Sakura Park for a while?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you mind if we go to the Sakura Park for a while?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ。花見の下見でもすんの？」
dialogues.en: "Sure. A preview for Saturday, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "Sure. A preview for Saturday, perhaps?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、ほら、この前、お姉ちゃんの結婚式
　に、歌を歌うって決めたでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"Nooo. Remember, we decided that I should sing something for
sis's wedding ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"Nooo. Remember, we decided that I should sing something for
sis's wedding ceremony."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それで、何を歌うか決めたから、早速練習し
　ようと思って」
dialogues.en:
"I've decided what I want to sing, so I need to practice a
lot for it."
dialogues.text:
"I've decided what I want to sing, so I need to practice a
lot for it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なるほどな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I get it."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I get it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「クレープ、おごるね♪　あ、バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "I'd treat you to a crepe as well♪ Ah, bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "I'd treat you to a crepe as well♪ Ah, bye bye!"

dialogues.jp:
廊下の向こうからやって来た女子に、笑顔で手
を挙げた。女子の方も笑顔で応じる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori raised her hand to the girls at the other side of the
corridor. The girls smiled and replied in turn.
dialogues.text:
Kotori raised her hand to the girls at the other side of the
corridor. The girls smiled and replied in turn.

dialogues.jp: 「友達？」
dialogues.en: "Your friends?"
dialogues.text: "Your friends?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　やだなあ、同じクラスの子だよ。分か
　らなかったの？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Nah, our classmates. Didn't you recognize them?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Nah, our classmates. Didn't you recognize them?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う……気づかなかった。でも、まあ、初日だ
　し」
dialogues.en:
"Ugh... I didn't even notice. Oh well, it's the first day
after all."
dialogues.text:
"Ugh... I didn't even notice. Oh well, it's the first day
after all."

dialogues.jp:
とは言え、顔と名前が一致するのがいつになる
のやら、自分でも分からない。
dialogues.en:
Although saying that, it's not like I know exactly when I'd
be able to match everyone's names with their faces.
dialogues.text:
Although saying that, it's not like I know exactly when I'd
be able to match everyone's names with their faces.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「駄目ですよ。ちゃんと、顔ぐらいは覚えてあ
　げないと」
dialogues.en: "You really have no memory for faces at all."
dialogues.text: "You really have no memory for faces at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「へ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Heeeey."
dialogues.text: "Heeeey."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、お姉さんか母親のようなたしなめる口
調に、俺は肩をすくめたのだった。
dialogues.en:
She mockingly patted me on the shoulder like an older sister
or a mother.
dialogues.text:
She mockingly patted me on the shoulder like an older sister
or a mother.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、ことりって、もうクラスの女子と普通
　に喋ってるよな」
dialogues.en:
"But, you're already talking so freely to those girls in
class, huh..."
dialogues.text:
"But, you're already talking so freely to those girls in
class, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　それが、どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What's wrong with that?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What's wrong with that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いや、初日なのに早いなと思って。普通、し
　ばらくはぎくしゃくしてるもんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, nothing. It's just that it seems a bit quick
considering it's the first day of school."
dialogues.text:
"Well, nothing. It's just that it seems a bit quick
considering it's the first day of school."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私、こう見えても、友達作るの早いんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"I've always been the type to make as many friends as
possible."
dialogues.text:
"I've always been the type to make as many friends as
possible."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……こう見えてもっていうか、ことりはまあ、
　そんな感じがするけどな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, it's pretty easy to see."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, it's pretty easy to see."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「人当たりがいいし、何て言うか、その、笑顔
　がいい」
dialogues.en:
"It's your attitude, and how you say it, the kind smile you
give everyone."
dialogues.text:
"It's your attitude, and how you say it, the kind smile you
give everyone."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、え〜……そう？　照れちゃいますな……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, eh~... you think so? That's sorta embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, eh~... you think so? That's sorta embarassing..."

dialogues.jp: 頬に手を当て、くねくねと身体をくねらせる。
dialogues.en: She placed her hands on her cheeks and squirmed a little.
dialogues.text: She placed her hands on her cheeks and squirmed a little.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、この分だったら、あのふたりと別のク
　ラスになったことも問題なしって感じか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, having seen that, at least I know it's no problem
that those two are in a different class."
dialogues.text:
"Well, having seen that, at least I know it's no problem
that those two are in a different class."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あのふたりって……みっくんとともちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "By "those two"... you mean Tomo-chan and Mik-kun?"
dialogues.text: "By "those two"... you mean Tomo-chan and Mik-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そう」
dialogues.en: "Yup."
dialogues.text: "Yup."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……あのふたりはね、特別だから。問
　題ないこともない」
dialogues.en:
"Weeell, those two are special. I wouldn't say it's no
problem."
dialogues.text:
"Weeell, those two are special. I wouldn't say it's no
problem."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。悪い」
dialogues.en: "Ah, sorry..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あのふたりはね、私が、この島に引っ越して
　くる前からの友達だから……」
dialogues.en:
"Those two were the first friends I made when I moved to
this island, so..."
dialogues.text:
"Those two were the first friends I made when I moved to
this island, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: （引っ越し……）
dialogues.en: "(Moved...)"
dialogues.text: "(Moved...)"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、クレープ屋さんだ。私、買ってくるね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's the crepe vendor! I'd go and buy some."
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's the crepe vendor! I'd go and buy some."

dialogues.jp:
屋台に繋がる行列の尻尾へと、ことりが走って
いく。
dialogues.en:
Kotori walked up to the cart and joined the tail end of the
queue.
dialogues.text:
Kotori walked up to the cart and joined the tail end of the
queue.

dialogues.jp: 「引っ越し……か」
dialogues.en: "Moved... huh."
dialogues.text: "Moved... huh."

dialogues.jp: いつか見た夢の内容を思い出す。
dialogues.en: The dream I had some time ago returned to my memory.
dialogues.text: The dream I had some time ago returned to my memory.

dialogues.jp: 家族みんなが……初めて会った人。
dialogues.en: Her relatives were all... people she met for the first time.
dialogues.text: Her relatives were all... people she met for the first time.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱりことりは、音夢と同じような境遇にあ
るのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Maybe Kotori was in the same circumstances that Nemu
encountered as well...
dialogues.text:
Maybe Kotori was in the same circumstances that Nemu
encountered as well...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ではでは、始めましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Then, I'd begin now!"
dialogues.text: "Then, I'd begin now!"

dialogues.jp:
指先をぺろりと舐め──クレープのアイスがつ
いていた──桜の大木を背中にする。
dialogues.en:
Licking her fingertips--the remains of the crepe were still
on it-- she leaned back onto the huge sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
Licking her fingertips--the remains of the crepe were still
on it-- she leaned back onto the huge sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んっ、んっ……んっ」
dialogues.en: "Mm mm.... ahem."
dialogues.text: "Mm mm.... ahem."

dialogues.jp: 何度か咳払い。一つ深呼吸。
dialogues.en: A few clearings of the throat. A deep breath.
dialogues.text: A few clearings of the throat. A deep breath.

dialogues.jp: そして、ことりは歌い始めた。
dialogues.en: Then the singing began.
dialogues.text: Then the singing began.

dialogues.jp:
それは、俺も知っているスタンダードな曲だっ
た。いかにも、結婚式で披露するのに相応しい
歌詞。
dialogues.en:
She was singing with her usual excellent standards. The song
itself was also fitting for a marriage ceremony.
dialogues.text:
She was singing with her usual excellent standards. The song
itself was also fitting for a marriage ceremony.

dialogues.jp:
その曲の本来の歌い手に優るとも劣らないこと
りの歌声。
dialogues.en:
The way Kotori was singing it, no one would've put her far
behind the original.
dialogues.text:
The way Kotori was singing it, no one would've put her far
behind the original.

dialogues.jp:
この歌声があるなら、『団子』はいらないかも
しれないな──そんな事を思いながら、俺は、
舞い散る桜を目で追っていた。
dialogues.en:
With this kind of singing voice, there's no need for any
"dumplings" -- was the last thing I thought, as I was
overcome...
dialogues.text:
With this kind of singing voice, there's no need for any
"dumplings" -- was the last thing I thought, as I was
overcome...

dialogues.jp:
目が覚めて、自分が眠りこけていたことに気が
付いた。
dialogues.en:
It took my awakening to make me realize that I had fallen
asleep.
dialogues.text:
It took my awakening to make me realize that I had fallen
asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あはっ……目、覚めちゃったね。童話と同じ
　で、そういう効能があるのかな」
dialogues.en:
"Aha... you woke up. Fairy tales really do tell the truth
sometimes."
dialogues.text:
"Aha... you woke up. Fairy tales really do tell the truth
sometimes."

dialogues.jp:
唇にちょこんと指を乗せ、そんなことを言って
くる。
dialogues.en: As she talked, she placed a finger on her lips.
dialogues.text: As she talked, she placed a finger on her lips.

dialogues.jp:
「猿ぐつわを噛まされて、ドナドナのように売
　られていく夢にうなされて起きたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I was dreaming that someone was stuffing a gag into my
mouth."
dialogues.text:
"I was dreaming that someone was stuffing a gag into my
mouth."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……私の口は、猿ぐつわじゃないよ〜」
dialogues.en: "What~... my mouth isn't a gag~"
dialogues.text: "What~... my mouth isn't a gag~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「にしても、いつのまにか眠ってたんだな。バ
　ラードな曲だから、子守歌になったのかな」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, just joking, I slept like a rock. That kind of ballad
serves as a lullaby to me."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, just joking, I slept like a rock. That kind of ballad
serves as a lullaby to me."

dialogues.jp:
幹に預けていた身体を立ち上がらせて、ぐっと
伸びをする。
dialogues.en:
I was sitting down, my body leaning against the tree trunk.
I stood up and stretched.
dialogues.text:
I was sitting down, my body leaning against the tree trunk.
I stood up and stretched.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「良く寝てたよ。だから私、途中で練習止め
　ちゃった」
dialogues.en:
"You really slept well. But I had to stop in the middle of
my practicing."
dialogues.text:
"You really slept well. But I had to stop in the middle of
my practicing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そりゃ悪かった……けど、何で？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, sorry... but why?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, sorry... but why?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え〜……だ、だって、何か、寝顔が可愛かっ
　たから……」
dialogues.en:
"Eh~... b, because, your looked so cute while you were
asleep..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh~... b, because, your looked so cute while you were
asleep..."

dialogues.jp: キスだけで済んだんだろな。
dialogues.en: I gave her a quick, light kiss.
dialogues.text: I gave her a quick, light kiss.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わ、わ〜！　私、そんな変なことやってない
　よ！」
dialogues.en: "Wa, wah~! I wasn't referring to anything weird like that!"
dialogues.text: "Wa, wah~! I wasn't referring to anything weird like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、微妙に説得力がないかも」
dialogues.en: "...Somehow, I'm not convinced."
dialogues.text: "...Somehow, I'm not convinced."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もう……変なところで起きちゃうんだから」
dialogues.en: "Geez... don't start thinking weird things."
dialogues.text: "Geez... don't start thinking weird things."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、そろそろ帰ろうぜ。暗くなってきてる」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, we should head back now. It's already dark."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, we should head back now. It's already dark."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、やっぱいいな。ことりの歌は」
dialogues.en: "Your singing really was good."
dialogues.text: "Your singing really was good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「またまた。寝てたくせに」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think it's good enough yet, especially if it put
you to sleep."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think it's good enough yet, especially if it put
you to sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、寝る前まではちゃんと起きてた」
dialogues.en: "No no, I fell asleep so that I could be woken up by you."
dialogues.text: "No no, I fell asleep so that I could be woken up by you."

dialogues.jp:
と、気を取り直したように、ことりがにこりと
した。
dialogues.en:
Pretty much ignoring what I said, Kotori looked at me
thoughtfully.
dialogues.text:
Pretty much ignoring what I said, Kotori looked at me
thoughtfully.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あの曲、メロディーラインがいいもんね」
dialogues.en: "That tune has a good melody line."
dialogues.text: "That tune has a good melody line."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもあるけど、歌声そのものが、な」
dialogues.en:
"Even if it has one, it needs a good singer to bring it out
as well."
dialogues.text:
"Even if it has one, it needs a good singer to bring it out
as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……そうかな？　私には、いまいち実
　感がないんだけどな……」
dialogues.en:
"Huhh... is that so? I don't really feel that way about
myself..."
dialogues.text:
"Huhh... is that so? I don't really feel that way about
myself..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　自分の歌に？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? About your own singing?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? About your own singing?"

dialogues.jp: ことりは、こくんとうなずく。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded affirmatively.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded affirmatively.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ。理想は高いと？」
dialogues.en: "Hm. Maybe your expectations are a little high?"
dialogues.text: "Hm. Maybe your expectations are a little high?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、そういうんじゃなくてね……」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not it..."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not it..."

dialogues.jp:
緩やかに首を振る。その先に続く言葉はなくて、
何となく会話が止まってしまった。
dialogues.en:
She lightly tipped her head to the side in thought. She
didn't continue her thought, and the conversation ended
there.
dialogues.text:
She lightly tipped her head to the side in thought. She
didn't continue her thought, and the conversation ended
there.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ここでいいよ」
dialogues.en: "This is far enough."
dialogues.text: "This is far enough."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん、分かった。じゃあ、気をつけてな」
dialogues.en: "Mm, okay. Be careful."
dialogues.text: "Mm, okay. Be careful."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "I will. Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "I will. Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……俺も帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "...Time for me to head back as well."
dialogues.text: "...Time for me to head back as well."

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ肌寒い風に、ぶるっと身震いする。俺
は、家路を急いだ。
dialogues.en:
The chilling wind was making me shiver. I quickly walked
down the road home.
dialogues.text:
The chilling wind was making me shiver. I quickly walked
down the road home.

dialogues.jp: ◆プレゼントの練習◆
dialogues.en: ◆Present Practice◆
dialogues.text: ◆Present Practice◆

dialogues.jp: 桜公園へと向かう。歌の練習をするためだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori and I went to the Sakura Park, in order to practice
her singing.
dialogues.text:
Kotori and I went to the Sakura Park, in order to practice
her singing.

dialogues.jp:
すれ違ったクラスメートに、ことりは親しげな
挨拶をした。ことりって、友達を作るのが早い
よな……。
dialogues.en:
Unlike me, Kotori was giving our classmates a friendly
farewell. She makes friends so quickly...
dialogues.text:
Unlike me, Kotori was giving our classmates a friendly
farewell. She makes friends so quickly...

dialogues.jp: そして、練習。
dialogues.en: And then, the practicing.
dialogues.text: And then, the practicing.

dialogues.jp: 眠ってしまい、気が付けば夜になっていた。
dialogues.en: I ended up falling asleep till night.
dialogues.text: I ended up falling asleep till night.
